summary: Recent updates in the connection transport area of Firefox, specifically related to ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) and DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security), focus on streamlining how certain methods are handled. By simplifying the RunnableMethod and InvokeAsync method handling, Firefox can enhance the efficiency of establishing secure connections for services like WebRTC, which is essential for real-time communications such as video calls. These changes are important as they help improve performance and reliability in connecting users, ultimately leading to a better experience in applications that rely on these technologies.
